targets.rawSql: WITH base AS (  SELECT h.aid, h.hostname, h.local_ip, h.external_ip, h.platform_name, h.os_version,         h.product_type_desc, h.agent_version, h.reduced_functionality_mode, h.cs_last_seen,         a.raw->>'cloud_provider'    AS cloud_provider,         a.raw->>'cloud_instance_id' AS instance_id,         a.raw->>'cloud_account_id'  AS cloud_account,         COALESCE(vc.open_total, 0)    AS open_total,         COALESCE(vc.open_critical, 0) AS open_critical  FROM falcon.hosts h  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT az.raw FROM falcon.assets az WHERE az.aid = h.aid    ORDER BY (az.entity_type='managed') DESC, az.last_seen_ts DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) a ON TRUE  LEFT JOIN (SELECT aid, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='open') AS open_total,             count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='open' AND severity='CRITICAL') AS open_critical             FROM falcon.vulns GROUP BY aid) vc ON vc.aid = h.aid),classified AS (  SELECT *,    CASE      WHEN cloud_provider = 'AWS' THEN 'AWS'      WHEN external_ip LIKE '92.207.176.2%'        AND (local_ip LIKE '10.20.7.%' OR local_ip LIKE '10.20.9.%' OR local_ip LIKE '10.20.98.%'             OR lower(hostname) LIKE 'lon%' OR lower(hostname) LIKE 'meeting%'             OR lower(hostname) LIKE 'cicd%')      THEN 'Office'      ELSE 'Other'    END AS category  FROM base) SELECT count(*) AS v FROM classified WHERE ('${host}' = '' OR hostname ILIKE '%${host}%' OR instance_id ILIKE '%${host}%') AND COALESCE(cloud_provider,'none') IN (${cloud:singlequote}) AND COALESCE(cloud_account,'none') IN (${cloud_account:singlequote}) AND COALESCE(platform_name,'UNKNOWN') IN (${platform:singlequote}) AND COALESCE(os_version,'UNKNOWN') IN (${os:singlequote}) AND ('${extip}' = '' OR external_ip ILIKE '%${extip}%')
